title: The embedded game window is still behaving incorrectly.
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in v4.6.rc1.official [481f36ed2]

### System information

Windows 11 - Godot Engine v4.6.rc1.official.481f36ed2 - https://godotengine.org D3D12 12_0 - Forward+ - Using Device #0: NVIDIA - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070

### Issue description

The embedded game window is still behaving incorrectly. In the other issue I had opened (#113462) it seems that it has not yet been resolved or perhaps the error is different.
As per the video below, what I observed:
If any tab below the engine has a different size before pressing play, the window bugs. For example: If the "Output" tab is configured to open when pressing play and if it has a different size than the "Debugger" tab, for example, the game screen inside the embedded "game" window behaves strangely. It seems that it starts with the height it had in the editor before pressing play and adjusts after switching tabs.
My suggestion: leave the game window invisible until it aligns and resizes correctly with the actual window size.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a786704d-8f76-44e3-97b5-d956d1891da6

### Steps to reproduce

Create an initial scene, add code that delays the game's loading time (I already submitted a project with a Fibonacci function for this in MRP) so you can see the screen. In the bottom Output tab, set the height low, and in the Debugger tab, set it to the middle of the editor, for example. Without changing the tab and keeping it in the debugger tab, play the game and see.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[new-game-project.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/24622018/new-game-project.zip)
